error[ZBX-E0610]: the container has no network of its own to make a socket in
  while  making a socket in the container web
  cause  the container web has no network of its own: it shares the host's
  name   web
  fix    start the container with a network of its own:   zbx run -d --name web --net none alpine -- sleep 1000
  more   zbx explain E0610
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0610.html
